newsitem.title: USA: NYS Dorm Auth plans $40 mln bond sale in two weeks.
newsitem.headline: NYS Dorm Auth plans $40 mln bond sale in two weeks.

text.p: The New York State Dormitory Authority on Friday said that it planned to sell within two weeks up to $40 million of bonds for the New York Foundling Charitable Corp.
The syndicate managing the sale will be led by Merrill Lynch, an official with the Authority said. He requested anonymity.

In August, the Authority plans to sell approximately $11 million of bonds for the Winthrop-University Hospital Association was planned. That syndicate would be led by J.P. Morgan Securities, the official said. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
